# Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Consult [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for design rationale and [`BOOT.md`](../BOOT.md) for actual runtime configuration. Keep provider integrations behind typed interfaces, use the OpenRouter Go SDK in `go.mod`, preserve the distinction between route and yes/no decisions, keep updates concise, and run `go test ./...` plus `go vet ./...` after Go changes.
